## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and affected modules.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, types, unit/integration tests, dataset validation, build and browser tests pass.
- [ ] Updated screenshots and documentation for changed behavior.
- [ ] Simulation claims match implemented behavior; no invented results.
- [ ] Reviewed dependencies, origin restrictions and telemetry contract changes.

## Risks

Note compatibility changes and remaining validation gaps.
